title: Exact successive free-cover columns before totalization
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $M^\bullet$ a cochain complex of $A$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. There exist a bicomplex $K^{p,q}$ with commuting horizontal and vertical differentials and a cochain map $a:K^{0,\bullet}\to M^\bullet$ such that every positive column is zero; for each $q$, the augmented row $\cdots\to K^{-2,q}\to K^{-1,q}\to K^{0,q}\xrightarrow{a}M^q\to0$ is exact, and the augmented row of vertical cycles is exact. For every $p\le0$ there is a degreewise split short exact sequence $0\to U_p^\bullet\to B_p^\bullet\to V_p^\bullet\to0$ with $B_p^\bullet\cong K^{p,\bullet}$, where $U_p$ and $V_p$ are coproducts of single copies of $A$ concentrated in integer degrees, indexed by types in the universe of $A$. No total complex or total augmentation is part of this statement.

proof.text: Set $N_0=M$. At each stage choose the cover $P_i\to N_i$ and its split two-step sequence using [lem-pc-derived-free-complex-cover]. Set $N_{i+1}=\ker(P_i\to N_i)$. Compose $P_{i+1}\to N_{i+1}$ with the kernel inclusion into $P_i$. The resulting successive maps compose to zero.

Degreewise surjectivity of the covers identifies each image with the next kernel, including the kernel of $P_0\to M$. If a cycle in $P_i$ maps to zero, its unique factor through the kernel $N_{i+1}$ is a cycle, since the kernel inclusion is injective and commutes with differentials. Cycle surjectivity of $P_{i+1}\to N_{i+1}$ lifts this cycle. This proves exactness of the augmented rows of terms and of cycles, including surjectivity at $M$.

Place P_i in horizontal degree -i and zero in positive degrees. The maps are cochain maps and their consecutive composites vanish by the kernel condition. Thus they define a bicomplex K. Set a to the first cover. Retain the split short exact sequence and the two coproduct decompositions supplied for each cover. No total complex or total augmentation is asserted here.

lean.statement: theorem exists_freeCoverColumns {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) : ∃ K : HomologicalComplex₂ (ModuleCat.{u} A) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ), ∃ a : K.X 0 ⟶ M, (∀ p : ℤ, 0 < p → IsZero (K.X p)) ∧ (∀ (p q : ℤ), p < -1 → Function.Exact ((K.d p (p + 1)).f q).hom ((K.d (p + 1) (p + 2)).f q).hom) ∧ (∀ q : ℤ, Function.Exact ((K.d (-1) 0).f q).hom (a.f q).hom) ∧ (∀ q : ℤ, Function.Surjective (a.f q).hom) ∧ (∀ (p q : ℤ), p < -1 → Function.Exact (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap (K.d p (p + 1)) q).hom (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap (K.d (p + 1) (p + 2)) q).hom) ∧ (∀ q : ℤ, Function.Exact (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap (K.d (-1) 0) q).hom (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap a q).hom) ∧ (∀ q : ℤ, Function.Surjective (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap a q).hom) ∧ (∀ p : ℤ, p ≤ 0 → ∃ S : ShortComplex (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ), Nonempty (S.X₂ ≅ K.X p) ∧ S.ShortExact ∧ (∀ k : ℤ, Nonempty (S.map (HomologicalComplex.eval (ModuleCat.{u} A) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) k)).Splitting) ∧ ∃ (I₁ I₃ : Type u) (d₁ : I₁ → ℤ) (d₃ : I₃ → ℤ), Nonempty (S.X₁ ≅ ∐ (fun i : I₁ ↦ (HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat.{u} A) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (d₁ i)).obj (ModuleCat.of A A))) ∧ Nonempty (S.X₃ ≅ ∐ (fun i : I₃ ↦ (HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat.{u} A) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (d₃ i)).obj (ModuleCat.of A A))))
